sources.reasoning_summary: The post notes that a whale has been depositing large amounts of AAVE and WLD into multiple exchanges over the past five days, implying continued selling pressure.
BNB is grinding higher with higher lows above a rising trendline; the bull case clears 760 toward 780 and 800, while the bear case rejects and loses 740 toward 725.
The author views Bitcoin's renewed rise in realized cap as a positive sign that could mark the early stage of a healthier market structure similar to 2023, provided it gets follow-through.
$85K has repeatedly turned Bitcoin back, with only five closes above it since January and never more than three in a row, making it a tough level to break.
Bitwise projects BTC will reach $1.6 million by 2036, driven by rising institutional demand, limited supply, and growing concerns over fiat currency debasement.

An Ethereum OG wallet inactive for three years deposited all 2,119 ETH (~$4.99M) to Coinbase seven hours ago, which the author frames as OGs waking up and dumping ETH, implying near-term selling pressure.

The author sees INITIA as a short opportunity once the paused chain resumes, arguing the +60% drift since the hack is artificial because spot selling is disabled while negative funding reflects pre-hedging, and expects a slow reaction to resumption similar to Humanity (H) after its hack.
A new wallet deposited 4M USDC into Hyperliquid and opened a 5x long on 3,000 XMR worth $1.77M, indicating a leveraged bullish position on XMR.
